videos.title: AI Uncovers a 14-Year-Old PHP Security Flaw 😳 #news #shorts #viral #usa #ai #internet #security
videos.description:
AI has helped uncover serious security flaws hidden in PHP, a programming language used across much of the internet.

The vulnerabilities, known as PHP2Shell, could allow attackers to execute code on vulnerable servers. Security researchers and developers have released fixes, making timely security updates essential.

This discovery highlights both the potential of AI to strengthen cybersecurity and the risks when powerful tools are used to find weaknesses in widely used software.

Follow World in a Flash for global news, technology breakthroughs and major developments explained in YouTube Shorts.

videos.description:
🚨 𝗠𝗶𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝗼𝗳𝘁 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀 𝗕𝘂𝘆𝗼𝘂𝘁𝘀 𝗔𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝘀 𝟮𝟳% 𝗼𝗳 𝗜𝘁𝘀 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗰𝗲

The voluntary exit offer covers vice presidents and below across the US, Canada, India, and the UK.

Participating teams include Windows, Copilot, Xbox, and finance, but data center staff and sales aren't included.

Employees have until early December to decide on the severance package, with departures set for December 31.

More than 30% of eligible staff accepted an earlier retirement buyout Microsoft ran this year.
